note: The game's RPCs (network messages) as its network configuration declares them (version 35; RPC index 10 bits on the wire): the name, the name's hash (MurmurHash64A, top 32 bits), whether a session id goes with it (session-bound), and each argument's kind, width and range. An argument is named after its type where that name is confirmed, else arg<n>. Index: the RPC's place in the configuration, sorted by hash (mods add their own, so it is only this build's vanilla order). Exported by scripts/ExportRpcs.py.
